title: Innokin Kwik 35K Sour Pineapple Ice Prefilled Pod + Refill
description: Sour Pineapple Ice combines tangy Pineapple with a frosty exhale for a bold, tropical vape that’s bright and cool. Every draw balances sweet and tart notes with a clean, chilled finish. This pack includes a 2ml prefilled pod and 10ml refill container for the Innokin Kwik 35K device. The mesh coil ensures flavour clarity, while the auto-feed design keeps performance steady How to Set Up Innokin Kwik 35K Prefilled Pod Step 1 Insert the prefilled pod into the Kwik 35K device until it clicks. Step 2 Fit the 10ml refill container securely into the base compartment. Step 3 Inhale on the mouthpiece to vape. Replace the pod pack once both chambers are empty. ✅ You're all set!
